result_blind_amendment.reason: The original mandatory-control prose named BP-warm CGLS K1, but the executable eligible-control roster omitted it. Before the complete-teacher READY barrier or any v141.3 feature, fit, prediction or score output existed, this amendment requires a physical 2A+2A^T replay and an independent second implementation so that a parameter-free same-cost parent can reject a learned-advantage claim.

warm_refinement_amendment.reason: A pre-result executable audit found that the frozen 2A+2A^T path formed Zero-CGLS K1 plus a learned exact-lift correction and then scored that state directly. It did not execute a subsequent unchanged CGLS refinement step, so calling the endpoint a warm-started CGLS result would be semantically false. Before complete-teacher READY or any v141.3 feature, fit, prediction or score output existed, this amendment retains that cheaper correction endpoint as initializer_k0 and adds one ordinary restarted CGLS step from its cached exact residual as warm_restart_k1 at 3A+3A^T. It also adds physical Zero-CGLS K3, BP-warm CGLS K2 and geometry-PCGLS K3 controls at the same 3A+3A^T budget.

scientific_question: Can one 7,361-parameter camera-permutation-equivariant direction-token model predict the preregistered truth-free pair_depth_projection_only teacher across five complete held-out PoolFire trajectories, first as a 2A+2A^T learned correction endpoint and, if needed, as a true 3A+3A^T warm initializer followed by one unchanged restarted CGLS step?
scientific_boundary: This contract fixes the deployment features, model, controls, folds and failure action before the complete teacher result is visible. Implementing or fitting it is not an algorithm result. A pass on the five opened trajectories would remain development mechanism evidence, not external generalization, resource speedup, curved-ray validity, real BOST, a paper success or a global novelty claim.

teacher_barrier.failure_action: Do not fit any model or control and do not inspect partial teacher coefficients.

camera_observable_features.per_modality: For observation, K1 residual and frozen deployment prediction separately: global active-set RMS normalization; per camera and component, the four fixed orthonormal 2x2 DCT-II coefficients; plus log(camera RMS/global active-set RMS).

direction_observable_features.definition: For each frozen direction: cosine with each globally normalized modality over all active cameras, cosine with each modality on the target camera, cosine with each modality on the peer camera or zero for parent directions, plus target and peer shares of direction energy.

direction_discrete_features.definition: Continuous encodings of pair flag, detector component, valid flags and normalized parent subtype, depth bin and angle branch; absolute target and peer camera indices are forbidden as numerical features and are used only to gather shared camera embeddings.

forbidden_inputs: absolute camera slot index as a numerical feature

primary_model.direction_head: shared [target32, peer32-or-zero, global32, observable11, discrete9] ->32->32->1 tanh MLP
primary_model.output_canonicalization: zero inactive directions, then unit RMS over the active direction roster
primary_model.optimizer: streamed full-fold Adam followed by eight deterministic unbounded L-BFGS iterations (equivalent to L-BFGS-B with no finite parameter bounds)
primary_model.epoch_batch_order: For each epoch, form camera-count-homogeneous batches after a deterministic PCG64 permutation within each count, then deterministically permute the combined batch roster with seed 14101 + fold_index + 100000*epoch.
primary_model.checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch only; no held-out checkpoint selection
primary_model.loss: fit-fold sample-equal mean squared unit-RMS coefficient error plus 1e-6 squared deviation of each pre-normalization raw RMS from one; the gauge term removes the otherwise unidentifiable raw-output scale without rewarding collapse toward zero

fold_local_normalization.camera_features: For every fit sample, average first and second moments equally over its active cameras; then average those per-sample moments equally over the 2,960 fit samples. Standard deviation floor is 1e-8.
fold_local_normalization.direction_observable_features: For every fit sample, average first and second moments equally over its active direction roster; then average those per-sample moments equally over the 2,960 fit samples. Standard deviation floor is 1e-8.
fold_local_normalization.direction_discrete_features: No fitted normalization; use the frozen bounded encoding.
fold_local_normalization.target: No fitted target scale: every sealed teacher coefficient vector is already unit RMS with a frozen physical sign orientation.

zero_parameter_residual_joint_ls.definition: Existing frozen pair_depth_residual_joint_ls_control with ridge fraction 1e-6; no fit and no truth. Its all-3700 coefficient predictions are sealed in the deployment feature barrier before scoring.

shared_linear_direction_token_ridge.interpretation: This is the current-roster dual-space ridge control: it predicts coefficients of the detector-dual direction roster with a shared linear map. It is the eligible ridge baseline for the 3700-cell contract; the older v67 nine-camera kernel dual ridge is reported only as historical context because its roster is not interchangeable.
shared_linear_direction_token_ridge.features: The identical 45 camera, 11 direction-observable and 9 direction-discrete features with shared target, peer and pooled raw camera features.
shared_linear_direction_token_ridge.ridge_parameterization: After fold-local feature normalization, minimize trajectory-balanced coefficient MSE plus lambda times the mean non-intercept Gram diagonal times the squared non-intercept parameter norm; the intercept is not penalized.
shared_linear_direction_token_ridge.selection: nested leave-one-complete-fit-trajectory-out mean coefficient MSE; each inner split recomputes camera and direction normalization using only its three inner-fit trajectories; ties choose the larger lambda

scaled_bp_restart_cgls_k1.definition: Compute x_BP = alpha A^T y with alpha=max(<y,A A^T y>,0)/||A A^T y||^2, then restart one ordinary CGLS step from x_BP using its observable residual. This is parameter-free and uses no CFD truth.
scaled_bp_restart_cgls_k1.formal_requirement: Physically replay all 3700 cells, seal the four-metric array and exact-call receipts, then independently recompute the field, residual, metrics and 2A+2A^T ledger without importing the formal helper.
scaled_bp_restart_cgls_k1.decision_role: If it passes every complete-trajectory accuracy tail, reject the learned-advantage claim regardless of whether a learned candidate passes.

three_pair_same_cost_controls.scaled_bp_restart_cgls_k2: Observable scaled BP followed by two ordinary restarted CGLS steps at exactly 3A+3A^T.
three_pair_same_cost_controls.geometry_pcgls_k3: Frozen geometry-only Jacobi PCGLS at exactly 3A+3A^T; the Jacobi map uses reported geometry only and no CFD truth.

same_or_lower_exact_call_baselines: PCGLS K1/K2/K3 at matched exact-call budgets

physical_replay_and_gate.candidate: Zero-CGLS K1 -> predicted deployment-visible direction mixture -> exact A^T lift -> observable residual line search gives initializer_k0; warm_restart_k1 then applies one ordinary restarted CGLS step from the cached exact residual.

initializer_k0.claim: learned correction endpoint, not a warm-refined CGLS result

warm_restart_k1.claim: true warm initializer followed by one unchanged restarted CGLS step

physical_replay_and_gate.minimal_success_rule: Evaluate all sealed 2A+2A^T correction endpoints before any 3A+3A^T warm-refined endpoint, and within one depth evaluate joint_ls, linear_ridge, then deep_set. A candidate must pass every complete-trajectory tail, no eligible legacy control at the same or lower exact-call budget may itself pass the complete gate, and no eligible same-or-lower-call control or earlier candidate may globally dominate it. A passing joint_ls rejects a learned-advantage claim; a passing linear_ridge rejects the need for the nonlinear Deep Sets model. Only a selected warm_restart_k1 candidate supports the literal warm-start-plus-CGLS interpretation.
physical_replay_and_gate.historical_v67_dual_ridge: Descriptive only: v67 contains 27270 arm rows over fixed nine-camera V66 geometries and a different trajectory/frame/condition roster. It cannot enter v141.3 dominance or accuracy decisions.
physical_replay_and_gate.failure_action: Close the fixed-target predictor route without CNN, FNO, UNO, DeepONet or larger Deep Sets rescue.

frozen_score_evidence.baseline_roster_rule: Every eligible baseline row must match trajectory, frame, active camera IDs, camera count, condition, factor, severity and repeat seed for all 3700 cells.

deferred_gates.fresh_wall_and_whole_pipeline_rss: Only after independent complete-trajectory matched-accuracy pass.
deferred_gates.real_bost: Only after the user supplies laboratory displacement images, camera calibration, repeat-noise information, masks and an approved baseline.
